title: SAFREE: Training-Free and Adaptive Guard for Safe Text-to-Image and Video Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical safeguard method (SAFREE) for content moderation in diffusion models (T2I and T2V). It aims to filter toxic concepts like nudity, violence, and artist styles. While it includes a standard ethics statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks as a core component of its research.
